title: Assignment 05 · Promissory estoppel and restitution
summary: Promissory estoppel and restitution. Assigned readings and principal cases for this class.
notes:
Ricketts v. Scothorn: A foreseeable, induced change of position supported enforcement of a gift promise even though quitting work was not the price the grandfather required in exchange.

Feinberg v. Pfeiffer Co.: The pension lacked bargained-for consideration, but Feinberg’s retirement in reliance on it supported enforcement under promissory estoppel.

Cohen v. Cowles Media Company: The Minnesota court rejected ordinary contract liability in this news-source setting but later upheld a damages award through promissory estoppel after constitutional review.

D & G Stout, Inc. v. Bacardi Imports, Inc.: An at-will distributorship assurance could support recovery for a foregone sale opportunity even though it did not guarantee future distributorship profits.

Additional assigned materials: Restatement § 90.
